name: Death frightened

It jumps a little, lands in that frightened arched pose and holds it, trembling. The cat stays centred.  Static camera, no zoom, pan or tilt; strict side view. Keep the exact painting style, colours, light and outline of the image. The cat stays the same size in every frame.

verdict: good: lands on the sheet's FRIGHTENED pose (arched, bristled, wide eyes) and holds it
